test_title: PYST 16: Selection Post (Graduation Level) - Reasoning (Held On 27 June, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: reasoning
question:
In this question, three statements are given, followed by two conclusions numbered I and II. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follows/follow from the statements.

**Statements:**

I. Some gates are ways.

II. All ways are routes.

III. No route is a door.

**Conclusions:**

I. No door is a way.

II. Some gates are routes.

options.text: Neither conclusion I nor II follows
Both conclusions I and II follow

solution:
Given:

I. Some gates are ways.

II. All ways are routes.

III. No route is a door.

The least possible Venn diagram for the given statement is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f5676265ba5e67b1d862747020570cc681f6d415bcccfb1a9fe26f6f8fade140.png] 

**CONCLUSIONS:**

I. No door is a way - **True (**Because, all ways are routes so that no door is a way).

II. Some gates are routes - **True (**Because, those parts of gates which is ways is also routes).

Thus, both conclusions I and II follow.

Hence, the correct answer is** "Option 3".**
